name: ActivityOutcomesDashboard
title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/ActivityOutcomesDashboard
summary: An activity outcomes dashboard: what a set of actors requested through the rules and what the rules decided. A page heading with the time range Select and a Refresh IconButton sits over a filter row: a `FilterMenu` with actor, outcome and category fields, its `FilterMenu.Chips`, and a destination Input. Every region reads the filters, and a filter that matches nothing shows a no-match state with Clear filters. A grid of seven StatTiles, four per row until the widest screens, counts the outcomes (requests, allowed, blocked, held, approved, denied and over budget), each with its delta against the previous period and a Hint that defines it. Below, a ChartCard plots outcomes over time as a Chart with stacked bars, one series per exclusive outcome in its status color (allowed success, blocked danger, held warning), with a legend that toggles a series and shows its total. Three ChartCards break the same requests down by actor, category and destination with a BarList each, and a last ChartCard holds the request log, a TableRoot with time, actor, an outcome Tag, category, a SeverityTag, destination, method and the rule that decided it. Built from `PageHeader`, `Select`, `IconButton`, `FilterMenu`, `Input`, `Button`, `StatTile`, `Hint`, `ChartCard`, `Chart`, `BarList`, `TableRoot`, `Table`, `Tag`, `SeverityTag`, `EmptyState` and, in Failed, `Alert`. A page body: render it in the default slot of ConsoleLayout, which owns the rail, the header and the main.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the time range loads, the tiles, the chart and the breakdowns render their own Skeleton and the log holds Skeleton rows, so the page does not reflow when data arrives.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: A time range with no request. The tiles show a dash with no delta, the chart and the breakdowns keep their box with an empty state, and the log says what fills it and to widen the time range.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: The request for the period failed: the tiles read as dashes, and every card keeps its header with a danger Alert that names what did not load and offers Retry.
